description: This file defines Sass functions and mixins related to responsive design breakpoints, including calculations of min/max widths, infix naming, and media query mixins for applying styles at different viewport sizes.

methods.name: breakpoint-next
methods.description: Calculates the next breakpoint name following the provided breakpoint name from the breakpoint list.

methods.name: breakpoint-min
methods.description: Returns the minimum width of the specified breakpoint, or null if it is the smallest.

methods.name: breakpoint-max
methods.description: Returns the maximum width for the specified breakpoint, reduced slightly to work with CSS media query limitations.

methods.name: breakpoint-infix
methods.description: Returns a string for infix naming in responsive utilities, empty for the smallest breakpoint.
